name: lanes
description: Run a lead session and lane sessions in tmux: a journal carries state, and a lane at its context threshold is cleared through a handshake and resumes from its RESUME block.

threshold.title: Clear threshold (% of context)
threshold.description: At or above this context use, the lead asks a lane to write its RESUME block and report clear-ready.

journal_dir.title: Journal folder
journal_dir.description: Where the journal lives, relative to the repository root or absolute (for a journal on its own branch or worktree).
